features: STURDY, COMPACT, LIGHTWEIGHT & ZERO MAINTENANCE: Dimensions: 11 x 8 x 5 cm. Weight: 170g. This ink-less, zero-maintenance thermal label printer requires no cartridges or ink, thanks to its smart thermal printing technology. Simply use cost-effective and eco-friendly thermal paper for printing.

MINI BLUETOOTH THERMAL PRINTER:This 58 mm mobile Bluetooth label printer connects seamlessly to any smartphone, tablet, or laptop via "WE PRINT" app. You can print labels, and stickers directly from your mobile device using thermal bluetooth printer. Compatible with Windows only.
203 DPI CLEAR HD PRINTING:The Seznik portable thermal printer features a compact and stylish design with high-definition printing clarity, offering sharper text compared to similar mini printers.

1500 MAh RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Enjoy long battery life, with up to 2 hours of continuous printing (about 500 labels roll) with our thermal printer for labelling. Charging time is 4-5 hours with a Type-C port for convenience.
THERMAL ROLL COMPATIBILITY: Supports thermal paper rolls with maximum roll diameter up to 5 cm and paper width up to 2 inches (≈50 mm) for smooth, jam-free printing, perfect gift for diwali.

FREE AFTER-SALES SERVICE & 24/7 CUSTOMER SUPPORT: We offer free installation and after-sales service, along with round-the-clock customer support for all our customers, and it also makes a thoughtful Diwali gift.
